li.label: it's my work now
li.description: I took this work on because nobody else would. I'm good at it now, and I've stopped minding it.

li.label: a fair wager
li.description: We had a bet on who'd do the most work. It was a good contest, and the drink afterwards was better.

li.label: won the wager
li.description: I did more work than they did, and they had to raise the cup to me in front of everyone.

li.label: told the old tales
li.description: I told the young one the stories I was told when I was small. Now someone else will remember them.

li.label: told me the old tales
li.description: They told me stories about the old days, and then told them to everyone because I asked.

li.label: a winter through
li.description: My first winter here is over. It was hard, and I got through it, and I know how it goes now.

li.label: told me how winter goes here
li.description: They told me what the winter here would be like before it came, and they were right about most of it.

li.label: a friend from the work
li.description: We love the same work, and we got talking about it. Now we're friends.

li.label: they came back
li.description: The people I got on with came by again. It's good to know someone out there remembers us.

li.label: kept my promise
li.description: When I was down I made a promise. I've kept it now, and I feel lighter for it.

li.label: trusted with the sick
li.description: The doctor says I can look after the sick on my own now. I've worked hard for that.

li.label: something new made
li.description: We've made something here we never had before. I'd like to make another one, a better one.

li.label: an evening with an old friend
li.description: We sat up and talked like we used to. I hadn't realized how much I missed it.

li.label: read to
li.description: Someone sat with me in the evening and read aloud, since my eyes can't do it any more.

li.label: the harvest in before the frost
li.description: The last of the crops came in before the cold could take them. We won't go hungry for want of a few days' work.

li.label: a snow day
li.description: We went out in the snow and built a snowman, and some of the grown-ups came too.

li.label: a word at the grave
li.description: I went to the grave and said what I wanted to say. It's a little easier now.

li.label: talked with the visitors
li.description: I spent an hour with the visitors and heard how things are where they come from.

li.label: an hour at the shrine
li.description: I had an hour to myself at the shrine. Nobody needed anything from me, and I could think.
